quest.title: Untainted Autumn Frost
quest.description: "Is the white-haired lady passing by an adeptus from Liyue?" "I can't tell. Can you?" "Me, neither..."

talks.objective: Talk to Luka and enter the tavern

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi there! Paimon would be more surprised to see you if we hadn't already seen a bunch of our friends...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Wait, you're Shenhe! This is a surprise!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: This place isn't easy to find. Angel's Share... The name doesn't exactly roll off the tongue.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhongli was kind enough to help me with directions. I'm thankful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You needed help with directions?... Wait, you came all this way just for a drink?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Because... we're friends.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here's the menu!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Boreal Watch... Hmm, Boreal? As in a cold climate?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Boreal Watch here probably is referring to the Wolf of the North. So yeah, you could say it's cold.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Caramel Pinecone... How could that be a drink?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon's tried that one. It's actually caramel flavored coffee. "Pinecone" just refers to the color!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Huh...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: These names are confusing. I can't make sense of any of these.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I'll leave it up to you. As long as it's something that tastes like Qingxin or Violetgrass.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those medicinal herbs don't grow around here. If you want something bitter, then it'd have to be coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How about something sweet instead?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a good idea. You've practiced the adepti arts long enough. It's time for something new!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's make Shenhe a Snow-Covered Kiss! It sounds like a perfect fit for her.

talks.objective: Head to the counter and get ready to open for business

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Hmm, it's sweet and smooth. Not bitter at all. What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's called a Snow-Covered Kiss! Whisk milk until it froths, and then gently pour it over some juice. It looks like it's covered by a layer of snow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't ask why it's called a kiss, though... Paimon doesn't get it either. It's probably just a gimmick to get it to sell better!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: A gimmick?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon's just guessing... Maybe it's more of a romantic description!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Romantic?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... It's hard to explain! Stop making Paimon come up with things.

choices.text: The milky foam doesn't have much taste to it...
The moment you taste the sweetness of the juice...

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I see. I seem to understand now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But wait, why is Paimon the one who's confused now!?

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Occasionally, I chew on divine herbs as I wander about in the mountains. I have witnessed the moment a new sprout breaks through the soil.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: The elation in my heart then does bear a resemblance to what I'm experiencing now.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: #Thank you for helping me understand these obscure names, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I might need your help again sometime in the future.

choices.text: Like a sprout pushing through the ice to give you a kiss...
It's kind of like snow on the mountains...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, this doesn't look like the drink they ordered. Just give this one to Paimon and try making another.
